title: Progress-Guarded LAVE: Lexer-Ignored Stall Filtering for Reliable CFG-Constrained Diffusion Decoding

contributions.purpose: Identify and formalize the failure mode where CFG-constrained diffusion decoding gets stuck generating grammar-ignored tokens.
contributions.mechanism: Characterization of the 'stall loop' failure mode, in which grammar-ignored tokens (whitespace, comments, newlines) remain technically valid and consume the length budget until truncation.
contributions.evaluation: Motivates the method; shows simple fixes fail (prompt engineering degrades performance, Best-of-N resampling has multiplicative compute cost).
contributions.source_quote: We identify and formalize the stall loop failure mode in CFG-constrained diffusion decoding, where grammar-ignored tokens cause truncation failures.

contributions.purpose: Prevent stall loops without modifying LAVE's core verification mechanism.
contributions.mechanism: PG-LAVE, a progress-aware early termination mechanism that extends LAVE's lookahead verification with a lightweight stall guard monitoring lexer progress (production of non-ignored terminals) and rejecting ignored-only proposals when progress stalls.
contributions.evaluation: Ablation shows lexer-progress tracking outperforms simple whitespace rejection heuristics; sensitivity analysis confirms robustness to the stall threshold for H>=16.
contributions.domain: reliable constrained decoding for diffusion LLMs
contributions.source_quote: We propose PG-LAVE, a progress-aware early termination mechanism that monitors lexer progress and rejects ignored-only proposals when progress has stalled.

contributions.purpose: Demonstrate PG-LAVE reduces truncation failures and improves output validity.
contributions.mechanism: Applying PG-LAVE's stall guard during CFG-constrained diffusion decoding.
contributions.evaluation: 40% relative reduction in truncation failures (1.83% vs 3.05% hit_max_len_rate) while improving syntactic validity by +0.81 percentage points (88.41% vs 87.60%) on CPP-Bench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct.
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate that PG-LAVE achieves a 40% relative reduction in truncation failures (1.83% vs 3.05% hit_max_len_rate) while improving syntactic validity by +0.81 percentage points on CPP-Bench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We propose Progress-Guarded LAVE (PG-LAVE), which extends LAVE's lookahead verification with a lightweight stall guard that monitors lexer progress.

LAVE (Zhang et al., 2026) provides reliable CFG-constrained decoding for dLLMs through lookahead verification... we leverage this signal to detect and prevent stall loops without modifying LAVE's core verification mechanism.
Our work complements these approaches by addressing a specific failure mode - stall loops in grammar-ignored tokens - that persists even with reliable constraint enforcement.
